recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision asks to change the separate element definition or broader route value set semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-20769 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking to replace the AllergyIntolerance RouteOfAdministration binding description from administration of a therapeutic agent to route or physiological path of exposure to a substance.
initial_application: Commit 46c303aefd7a90848fb2a89aeac377d752fe262c applied GF#20769 to source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-spreadsheet.xml by changing the binding description to "A coded concept describing the route or physiological path of exposure to a substance." Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later migrated AllergyIntolerance source into StructureDefinition XML and preserved that wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists AllergyIntolerance, so source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml is in build scope. Current source has the requested binding description at lines 745-751 while retaining the separate element definition at lines 735-739. Patient Care minutes from 2019-04-11 record GF#20769 as resolved. Source and community searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build-scope StructureDefinition already satisfies the Jira resolution for the binding description, and the only therapeutic-agent text found under source/allergyintolerance outside SVGs is unrelated AllergyIntolerance.category terminology content.
